title: Corridor sync playbook — weekly prep notes (Ena)
content:
Context: quick corridor-style prep for the weekly cross-pillar sync. This is a working doc / cheat-sheet for me to run the 30m meeting and capture action items. Keep it tight; 3 big things max.

Meeting meta:
- Cadence: weekly (Wednesdays) 30m
- Timebox: 30m sharp (5m triage, 15m deep item, 8m quick updates, 2m actions)
- Typical attendees: serving-runtime, infra, console leads + rotating engineer (opt-in)
- Goal: unblock cross-pillar ops, decide on immediate rollouts/fallbacks, track regressions that affect SLA/cost

Priorities for this week (pick 3):
1) Latency regression observed on tail for model-x at p95 — need root-cause hypothesis and mitigations (cache warming vs routing fallback)
2) Console rollout for per-route token accounting — one blocker (auth scope) needs a decision
3) Autoscaling policy tweak for Dedicated pools — validate recent load spike behaviour

Pre-reads (1–2 bullets each):
- Latency spike: quick trace summary (SERV-560) + sampling of 8 traces attached in PR comments (link above). Read 1 paragraph.
- Console change: UI + API contract in PR (#789) — focus on auth scope note in description.
- Autoscale: infra runbook excerpt from INFR-3421 (second section).

Agenda (30m):
1) 00:00–05:00 — quick state-of-world: outages/regressions, any customer escalations (callouts: CS ticket #4312)
2) 05:00–20:00 — deep item: latency regression (who has traces? Arjun to summarize)
   - Hypotheses: new kernel selection, batching changes, KV cache invalidation window, routing fallback misconfig
   - Quick experiments: enable prefix caching for 10% traffic, pin older quantized variant for 5% as fallback, force local-kv TTL=30s
3) 20:00–28:00 — short updates (console auth scope, autoscale tweak verification, ongoing evals)
4) 28:00–30:00 — action item review and owners assigned

Running notes / cues to myself:
- Start meeting by asking: any Sev incidents? If yes, move that to top and extend time (post-hoc follow-up).
- Keep the latency deep dive focused on 2 measurable experiments we can start immediately. Avoid re-hashing historical debates.
- Call out cost impact: estimate tokens/sec delta if fallback used.
- If we can't decide on autoscale param in 15m, create short follow-up breakout with infra + runtime engineers.

Quick metrics snapshot (for screen share):
- p50/p95/p99 for model-x last 24h: 12ms / 210ms / 1.2s (note: p95 jumped from 130ms baseline)
- Error rate: 0.03% (no customer-facing increase)
- Dedicated pool utilization last 3 hours: 78% -> spike to 94% at 09:12 UTC

Decision points (need explicit Y/N or owner+deadline):
- Approve pinning model-variant-v2-q8 to the latency-critical route (Y/N) — owner: Arjun — due EOD tomorrow
- Accept console auth-scope patch (merge?) — owner: Maya — due before next deploy window (Thu AM)
- Fast-fail fallback policy enablement for region-eu under high queueing — owner: Samir — evaluate by Wednesday next week

Action items (temp tracker — copy these to Jira after meeting):
- AI-1: Run 10% prefix-cache enabling experiment and report delta on p95 — owner: Arjun — due: 2026-03-13 — status: in_progress
- AI-2: Add auth-scope test case + e2e smoke for per-route accounting — owner: Maya — due: 2026-03-14 — status: todo
- AI-3: Validate autoscale cooldown behavior with synthetic spike and share logs — owner: Samir — due: 2026-03-15 — status: todo
- AI-4: Draft customer message template if we need to notify impacted customers — owner: Ena Park — due: 2026-03-13 — status: drafting
- AI-5: Create a short runbook note on how to force fallback routing in prod for FR emergency — owner: Lina (ops) — due: 2026-03-16 — status: todo

Notes-to-self / follow-ups after meeting:
- Remember to convert AI-1/AI-2 into Jira tickets with proper acceptance criteria and testing instructions.
- Ping platform on infra slack if autoscale validation shows non-deterministic behaviour (use #infra-alerts).
- Save a zip of traces we looked at and attach to SERV-560.
- If Arjun's experiment reduces p95 < 160ms, prepare rollback plan for pin (get approvals).

Staging runner checklist (if we need to spin quick experiment):
- confirm test route has traffic mirror set (flag: mirror/ena-experiment)
- ensure no persistent KV eviction overrides in staging
- set canary label and throttle to 10% using routing policy tool (console)
- pre-signed logs retention 48h for easier trace capture

Loose ideas / backlog items (timebox 5m in next sync if no high priority items):
- Evaluate per-tenant KV cache heuristics (cost vs latency)
- Small UI affordance: show estimated token cost per route on console before deploy
- Automation: one-click enable/disable of prefix caching for canary workflows

Tone & facilitation notes:
- Keep it pragmatic and outcome-oriented. If we need more time, spin a 15m follow-up with only the stakeholders.
- Use whiteboard share to sketch routing fallback flow quickly.

End-of-doc: rough transcript template for meeting minutes (copy into meeting notes channel):
- Summary: <one line>
- Decisions: <bullet list>
- Actions: <bullet list with owners/due dates>
- Next deep item for next week: <topic>
